tools.name: gumlet_get_user
tools.description: Get the user that owns the API key: name, email, roles and timezone. Gumlet API: GET /v1/user/data.

tools.name: gumlet_list_workspaces
tools.description: List video workspaces assigned to the API key. A workspace holds assets, folders and playlists. Start here to get a workspace_id. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/workspaces.

tools.name: gumlet_get_workspace
tools.description: Get one video workspace: name, type, default profile, insights setting, player config and video protection. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/workspaces/{workspace_id}.

tools.name: gumlet_list_assets
tools.description: List video assets in a workspace, with filters for status, tag, title, folder, playlist and upload date. Returns asset ids and distinct tags. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/assets/list/{workspace_id}.

tools.name: gumlet_get_asset
tools.description: Get one video asset: processing status and progress, input details (duration, size, resolution), playback and thumbnail URLs, folder, playlists and tags. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/assets/{asset_id}.

tools.name: gumlet_list_recycle_bin
tools.description: List assets in the recycle bin of a workspace (deleted, not yet purged). Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/asset/recoverable/list.

tools.name: gumlet_list_folders
tools.description: List folders in a workspace, or the sub-folders of one parent folder. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/workspaces/{workspace_id}/folders.

tools.name: gumlet_list_profiles
tools.description: List video profiles. A profile is a saved set of encoding settings applied when creating assets. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/profiles.

tools.name: gumlet_get_profile
tools.description: Get one video profile: output format, codecs, resolution, thumbnail and chapter settings. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/profiles/{profile_id}.

tools.name: gumlet_list_playlists
tools.description: List playlists in a workspace or collection. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/playlist.

tools.name: gumlet_get_playlist_assets
tools.description: List the assets in one playlist, in playlist order or sorted. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/playlist/{playlist_id}/assets.

tools.name: gumlet_top_streamed_assets
tools.description: List the most streamed assets in a date range (at most 60 days), optionally for one workspace or collection. Gumlet API: GET /v1/video/streaming-duration.

tools.name: gumlet_video_analytics
tools.description: Get video usage numbers for a date range: bandwidth, asset duration, storage, top assets, DRM requests, AI credit use and errored videos. Read-only, despite the POST method. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/analytics.

tools.name: gumlet_viewer_analytics
tools.description: Get viewer metrics for one workspace: views, unique views, impressions, completion, playing time, concurrent users, form submits and CTA clicks. Date range at most 60 days. Read-only, despite the POST method. Gumlet API: POST /v1/insights/viewer-analytics.

tools.name: gumlet_list_image_sources
tools.description: List image delivery sources (subdomains) assigned to the API key. Gumlet API: GET /v1/image/sources.

tools.name: gumlet_create_asset
tools.description: Create a new video asset in a workspace from a public video URL (input). The API then processes the video. Does not delete anything. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/assets.

tools.name: gumlet_update_asset
tools.description: Change the title, description or tags of an existing asset. Does not change the video file or re-process it. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/assets/update.

tools.name: gumlet_select_thumbnail
tools.description: Set an asset's thumbnail to the video frame at a given second. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/assets/{asset_id}/thumbnail-select.

tools.name: gumlet_create_folder
tools.description: Create a folder in a workspace, optionally inside a parent folder. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/workspaces/{workspace_id}/folders.

tools.name: gumlet_create_playlist
tools.description: Create a playlist in a workspace. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/playlist.

tools.name: gumlet_add_assets_to_playlist
tools.description: Add one or more assets to a playlist, at the end or at a given position. Gumlet API: POST /v1/video/playlist/{playlist_id}/asset.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_get_asset, gumlet_video_analytics, gumlet_viewer_analytics · Private data: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_list_workspaces, gumlet_list_image_sources, gumlet_update_asset · Public sink: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_list_assets, gumlet_video_analytics, gumlet_viewer_analytics, gumlet_create_asset, gumlet_update_asset, gumlet_select_thumbnail, gumlet_create_folder, gumlet_create_playlist, gumlet_add_assets_to_playlist · Destructive: gumlet_get_profile, gumlet_create_asset.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_get_asset, gumlet_video_analytics, gumlet_viewer_analytics · Private data: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_list_workspaces, gumlet_list_image_sources, gumlet_update_asset · Public sink: gumlet_get_user, gumlet_list_assets, gumlet_video_analytics, gumlet_viewer_analytics, gumlet_create_asset, gumlet_update_asset, gumlet_select_thumbnail, gumlet_create_folder, gumlet_create_playlist, gumlet_add_assets_to_playlist · Destructive: gumlet_get_profile, gumlet_create_asset

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
